notes.title: Release Date Annoucement and Inclusion in Indie Game Festivals on now!
notes.content: [p]Hello Everyone![/p][p]We've been hard at work on the Full Release of the Game and we are ecstatic to announce that the [b]release date will be 26th September[/b]![/p][p]We've made a whole range of changes to the game to make each run feel different and push the player to come up with strategies to exploit what's made available in any particular run.[/p][p]See the Release Date Announcement Trailer on the Steam page or at: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/bTKk6K2UXSU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We are also excited to be included in the following awesome Festivals on Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/9f63ab9d545ba9150c6383724ec3b8dc46d670a5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/4d91c6a8772a1071f4bebbe76d71539c9fe68372.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update on Release Date
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/e61c95e69cd78221a25cbc57466ea994819c4c7a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We have decided to delay the release of the game until September (instead of the planned date of 25th July) to ensure the game has been thoroughly tested.[/p][p]It's been a rough combo of sickness, testing taking longer than expected, and having other commitments take priority recently.[/p][p]But enough with the excuses... This Update's update on differences between the Demo and Full Release are: [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="135,151,"][tr][th colwidth="135"][p][/p][/th][th colwidth="151"][p]Demo[/p][/th][th][p]Full Release[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Crest resources[/p][/td][td colwidth="151"][p]Not available[/p][/td][td][p]Each King has a corresponding Crest resource, which when used quickens the pace of the game by increasing favour gain and immediately ending Grace Period.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Ascension Powder resource[/p][/td][td colwidth="151"][p]Adds one of two unique effects to a random card in hand when used.[/p][/td][td][p]Passively gives +1 upgrade whenever a Card is upgraded (e.g. accelerating a card in the Vault, or using the Temper Hand unique effect). This keeps upgrading Cards in this way relevant into the late game. Ascension powder can be used if a particular Perk is unlocked and active, where it greatly buffs a number of Cards equal to the amount of Ascension powder used.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing :)[/p]

notes.title: New Tutorial being rolled out in the lead up to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Hope you've been enjoying the demo so far.

We're rolling out a new Tutorial mode that introduces mechanics one by one on a simplified Board. It explains and show what things do and what the strategic value is. We will release regular updates to cover all the Tutorial topics visible on the new Tutorial Selection screen throughout the next week. The old tutorial has been renamed as Guidance mode, and is still in the game if you want to use it.

Here's what the new Tutorial Selection screen looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/6d788adcd24d375ae6841208071c6fb546c774a4.png[/img]

And here's an example of a simplified Board:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/8be852090f122c6c08c9a540bf55872a218fe7ad.png[/img]

In order to make the new Tutorial mode, incorporating a lot of feedback from players and streamers, we've been busy overhauling the game's code to make new things possible. The key features:
[olist]
[*]Allowing us to define deterministic outcomes from game mechanics that are by design/default random.
[*]Allowing us to forcing the player to follow tutorial instructions.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updates to Demo
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Hope you've been enjoying the demo so far.

Since releasing the demo, we've been getting fantastic feedback, particularly on the [i]new player experience[/i] and that it is quite daunting.

Our philosophy has been to encourage exploration and give space to the player to piece things together and get that great feeling of doing something clever. As such we had tooltips everywhere we could think of and had non-intrusive pop-up tips that are triggered by things the player does to help provide more insight/context. 

That said, we hear the feedback loud and clear. [b]So we've added a tutorial that runs through the basics and also guides the player through the first 6 turns[/b], following a deterministic pattern of play that results in pretty solid start to a run.

We are always looking for feedback to make the game better and more fun. We've also added a link to a Feedback Form in-game (in the main menu and the win/lose screen) that links to a Google Form. Please feel free to use the form whenever you'd like to give feedback!

Thanks for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/2658a37ae4d170117eb0401440d597a15a1725f7.png[/img]
